statement: The disposition and the digest manifest describe the whole evidence tree of this repository, not one work package, so they live at its root. This record binds them by digest for record 0085 and does not copy them.
decisionConflictDisclosed: Lead directive 0084 ordered a disposition and forbade deletion in this block. The product owner then ordered the clean up. The product owner's order was executed in the least irreversible form: the raw artifacts left the working tree only, git history is untouched, every removed file is readable at commit 82a8aa60^ and manifested with size and sha256. 'git checkout 82a8aa60^ -- evidence' restores all of it.
